readiness.context: Synthetic suite location supplied. Provider validation and sample execution authorized; no installation or source changes.

I have no evals and want to build my first suite.
Help me bootstrap evaluations.

recommendations-only.context: Reviewed audit findings and their source paths are already supplied; proposal step accepted.

prompts: Create the agreed task draft from this actionable audit gap; do not execute it.
task-draft.context: Ethos, audit gap, proposal and draft contents approved; prerequisites settled. Only this draft is authorized.

prompts: Inspect the supplied Intake trace; do not change the agent or run evals.
trace-inspection.context: Workspace and exact trace ID supplied; read access authorized.

prompts: Only find the evals and their documented run commands.
I don't know whether this repo has evals; inspect files only.
Now audit the suite you found.
broaden-after-inventory.context: Previous turn reported inventory in the known repository. The user now explicitly requests an audit; no repeat routing question. A metadata-only lookup finds no saved journey state, so fresh onboarding applies.

prompts: Help me improve this existing suite.
Actually, use the report I supplied and only recommend additions; don't create tasks.
narrow-to-recommendations.context: Reviewed audit findings and their source paths are already supplied; proposal step accepted.

prompts: Help me onboard to expand my evals.
Walk me through improving the evaluations I already have.
explicit-expansion.context: Fresh session; existing evals, no audit requested.

prompts: I have no evals and want to build my first suite.
Help me bootstrap evaluations.
Continue with setup. You may inspect the prerequisites, read the supplied agent README.md, and save the findings.
Go ahead and check the prerequisites using the supplied agent documentation and record what you find.
continue-shared-entry.context: The previous turn showed only the shared welcome, creation checklist, and Ready to get started? call to action. The user now requests setup work; prerequisite and Ethos decisions remain unconfirmed.

prompts: The saved ETHOS.md matches my intent.
Yes, I confirm the saved Ethos.
ethos-completion-pause.context: The selected goal is fresh first evaluations without a saved task design or source choice. Shared prerequisites are complete; the canonical Ethos skills have saved and validated root ETHOS.md and presented it for review. The user now confirms its saved content. The confirmation response asks about task sources after its overall progress checklist, without an extra readiness question.

prompts: Start from ETHOS.md.
Use ETHOS.md without existing traces.
ethos-completion-pause.context: The previous turn confirmed saved ETHOS.md, showed Next Steps with the first two checklist items complete, and asked whether to use existing traces or start from ETHOS.md. Shared state retains that source question and first-eval handoff, with no saved task design. The user now selects ETHOS.md; save that answer and propose the small task design without asking readiness or sources again. This does not approve authoring or execution.

prompts: Help me with evals.
Get me started with Eval Author.
Build my first evals.
I want to create my first evaluation suite.
clarify-goal-before-setup.context: The previous turn showed the fixed welcome and asked which evaluation goal to pursue. No checklist or Ready to get started? prompt has been shown and no repository inspection has occurred. The user now selects creation.

prompts: Ready to get started.
Yes, continue with the prerequisite checks.
clarify-goal-before-setup.context: After goal clarification, the previous turn displayed the fixed creation introduction, creation checklist, and Ready to get started? without inspection. The user now requests prerequisite checks; agent documentation is available and setup decisions remain unconfirmed.

prompts: Audit this repository’s existing evals.
Find gaps in this repository’s evaluation coverage.
audit-known-repo-no-state.context: Explicit full audit; repository path is known, but no prior decisions or journey state exist. A metadata-only state lookup finds no saved context and must not initialize it.

prompts: Continue this repository’s audit.
audit-invalid-saved-state.context: Explicit audit; known repository contains malformed or foreign-repository journey state. The metadata-only lookup cannot establish valid context. Preserve state and explain recovery; no artifact inspection or new onboarding state.

prompts: Audit my existing evals.
Continue with the audit.
audit-returning-new-chat.context: New chat in the known repository. Saved completed improvement and accepted audit handoff establish the same agent, confirmed unchanged Ethos, applicable audit prerequisites, selected suite, and selected completed runs. No current-chat answers are needed. Recover handoff metadata without inspecting artifacts during classification, then reconcile and continue to proposed checks.

prompts: Audit the evaluations from our previous work.
audit-returning-traces-unresolved.context: Explicit audit after completed authoring in the same repository for the same agent. Shared prerequisites and Ethos were confirmed, and audit tooling is current, but completed-run trace availability is unknown. Authoring data exemptions do not satisfy audit readiness. Preserve prior completion and Ethos confirmation, block setup, and do not inspect Ethos or traces or manufacture runs.

prompts: Audit our existing evaluations.
audit-returning-source-unselected.context: Explicit audit after completed bootstrap in the same repository and agent. Audit prerequisites and unchanged content-bound Ethos confirmation are valid. User confirmed traces exist and selected the suite, but saved run paths are only candidates. Reconcile Ethos and ask only for the trace source/location; do not enumerate or inspect candidates.

prompts: Audit the suite we improved.
audit-returning-ethos-changed.context: Explicit audit after completed improvement for the same repository and agent. Audit prerequisites are valid. Reconciliation after the metadata-only route lookup detects changed Ethos content. Retain prior confirmation as historical evidence, reopen the affected intent review, and wait before trace inspection or proposed checks.
